title: Clanging Clavo
description: A metallic FM bass-lead in the mid-low register — clangy and rubbery, almost singing. Inharmonic fmh ratios give it a bell-like clang while a melodic bass riff carries a reggaeton hook. FM index, filter, and pan LFOs run on mutually-prime cycles (7, 13, 16, 17, 24) so the loop stays alive through its 32-cycle arc.
code:
setcpm(100/4)
stack(
  note("<c2 eb2 g1 bb1>*2").s("sine")
    .fmh("<2.01 3.99 1.5 5.0>/4")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(3, 11))
    .add(note("<0 0 7 0 5 0 2 0>/7"))
    .penv("<6 0 10 0 8 0 4 2>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.04)
    .lpf(sine.slow(13).range(400, 3200)).resonance(sine.slow(17).range(6, 16)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<3 1 5 2>/4").lpattack(0.002).lpdecay(0.12)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.18).sustain(0.55).release(0.08)
    .shape(sine.slow(24).range(0.15, 0.45))
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28).pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.7, 0.3)))
    .delay("0.3:0.25:0.5").room(0.18)
    .gain(0.88)
)
